_doc: Enemy types (GAME_DESIGN.md: Enemies, elites, and difficulty). The two PLACEHOLDER enemies stay for tests and the debug menu. Aegean Shore families from the design: Shades, Harpies, Sirens (casters), Satyr skirmishers; Draugr brutes and Muspel Spark bombers are borrowed from the shared family table so every movement type appears; elites are the design's larger mythic creatures (Minotaur, Cyclops, Gorgon-kin). Elements for Sirens, Satyrs, and the elites aren't given in the design and are placeholders (see docs/DECISIONS.md). Speeds px/s; radius_px is body size. behavior holds movement settings: flyer (wave_px, wave_hz, lifetime_s), caster (range_px, cooldown_s, telegraph_s, projectile_*), bomber (trigger_px, fuse_s, blast_*). ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS.
